```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.width = 6,
  fig.asp = .6,
  out.width = "90%"
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

options(
  ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis",
  ggplot2.continuous.fill = "viridis"
)

scale_colour_discrete = scale_colour_viridis_d
scale_fill_discrete = scale_fill_viridis_d
```
#Problem 1

load the data

```{r}
data("ny_noaa")
```

## data cleaning

```{r}
ny_noaa_df = ny_noaa |>
  mutate(
    year  = year(date),   
    month = month(date),  
    day   = mday(date),
    prcp = prcp / 10,       
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10, 
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10
  ) 

dim(ny_noaa_df)
summary(ny_noaa_df)

ny_noaa_df |>
  count(snow) |>
  head(10)
```

##January vs July

```{r}
mean_tmax = ny_noaa_df |>
  filter(month == 1 | month == 7) |>
  mutate(
    month = factor(month, levels = c(1,7), labels = c("January", "July"))
  ) |>
  group_by(id, year, month) |>
  summarise(
    mean_tmax = mean(tmax, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  view()
```

```{r}
mean_tmax |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(year), y = mean_tmax, colour = month)) + 
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = month), se = FALSE) + 
  facet_grid(. ~ month) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    breaks = seq(1980, 2010, by = 5)
  ) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE) + 
  labs(
    title = "Average Max Temperature Trend in January and July ", 
    x = "Year", 
    y = "Max Temp",
    caption = "Average Max Temperature in January and in July in Each Station Across Years",
    color = "Month"
  ) 
```

```{r}
ny_noaa_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) + 
  geom_hex() 


ny_noaa_df |>
  filter(snow > 0, snow < 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(year), y = snow )) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Snowfall (mm)", y = "Year", title = "Snowfall (0 < snow < 100 mm) by year") 


```
